title: Zeros of the generalized Wronskian-Hermite polynomials
summary: In this paper, we study generalized Wronskian-Hermite (WH) polynomials associated with arithmetic-progression index sets. We verify the conjecture that all nonzero roots are simple for three subclasses of these polynomials, which, in a natural sense, cover more than half of the relevant parameter range. We also provide an interpretation of the root multiplicity at $z=0$ in terms of Young diagrams. In addition, we show that certain members of generalized WH polynomials provide representations of rational solutions of the Noumi-Yamada systems, a family of higher-order Painlevé equations.…
